ElevenAgents now integrates natively with the leading CCaaS platforms: Genesys Cloud, NiCE , Amazon Connect and Five9 . 

Enterprises can now put the most natural, responsive voice agents in front of their customers, inside the call flows they already run. Your routing, workforce management, compliance recording and CRM all stay the same.

Running on something else? We’ve got you covered. ElevenAgents connects over SIP to your existing telephony infrastructure.
